_about: Mission environments. Drives the triage engine's escalation policy: the longer the comms delay, the more the app guides the crew to act on their own before ground replies.

environments.name: Low Earth orbit (space station)
environments.red_tier_guidance: Contact flight surgeon now - near-real-time voice available.

environments.name: Moon (orbit or surface)
environments.red_tier_guidance: Contact flight surgeon - ~2.6 s round trip; conversation works with turn-taking. Start first-aid steps while connecting.

environments.name: Mars transit
environments.red_tier_guidance: Follow on-board protocol immediately and involve the crew medical officer. Send a store-and-forward report to ground; reply may take 6-45 min round trip.

environments.name: Mars surface base
environments.red_tier_guidance: Same as transit. Note: near solar conjunction, contact can be lost for ~2-3 weeks.
